name: 奉仕時間の記録タイムライン
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
One Japanese Lighthouse LH11-0010 奉仕時間の記録タイムライン component. Image1 ORIGINAL Jobber source takes priority for timeline-marker and chain-link glyph geometry, optical size/stroke, alignment, spacing and fine card details. Image2 Japanese mock is SECONDARY localized copy/layout guide; its gray outer canvas and rough link shape must not be copied. Image3 approved bus is white cards/soft elevation style only.
Render compact timeline at logical390x273 proportions, high resolution, pure white #FFFFFF canvas. Two WHITE rounded record cards to the right of a thin LIGHT NEUTRAL vertical rail. Small HOLLOW WHITE circular rail markers with fine neutral outline, source-style at record boundaries; a third unlabeled endpoint circle may finish rail below second card, matching source anatomy, but do not invent a third time or record. Existing localized first time label 「12:13」 above first card and second 「11:47」 above second card are the only time labels. Source has other time values; keep our saved localized values explicitly, no invented timeline events.
First card: bold compact summary 「奉仕時間 00:30」 with quiet forest-green text action 「編集」 at right, then regular 「準備奉仕」 below. Second card: bold compact 「奉仕時間 01:00」 and same 「編集」 action; thin neutral inset divider below summary, then regular 「山田 太郎・受付」 and a small forest-green CHAIN-LINK action at right. Match ORIGINAL link symbol: two rounded oblong open chain links diagonally interlocked at45degrees, correct gaps and consistent optical weight, not the mock's rough substitute. Source utilities are modest (about14–16logicalpx), not oversized ornamental glyphs. Rail circles remain neutral; do not recolor them green.
Meiryo body14/24 regular, summary modest bold14/24, time/actions metadata12/16, tracking0, preserve wrapping and compact rhythm. White rounded cards, fine neutral borders, soft subtle downward shadow. Source green edit/link actions adapt consistently to forest-green #1F6444; no primary filled button exists in this component, so no invented gradient button. No additional accents, mint fills, gray canvas, avatars, top calendar/check-in strip, navigation, phone frame, plus button or metrics. All exact Japanese content and00:30/01:00 preserved. Static raster design candidate only, no real timeline/runtime or navigation claimed.
reviewNotes: 原画優先の中立軸/三つの空円/小リンク形状と二カード構造を復元。保存日本語と12:13/11:47、00:30/01:00、準備奉仕/山田太郎・受付を保持。編集/リンクは森林緑、軸は中立、外背景白。第三時刻/記録は創作なし。実画像で本文/整列/切れなし確認。書体同定/ピクセル一致/実タイムライン動作は未検証、画像レビューのみ。
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
